data.title: Altus
data.about:
Introducing Altus, situated in the vibrant heart of Dubai Creek Harbour and developed by the renowned Emaar Properties. This luxurious residential complex features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments. The project redefines opulent living with its premium apartments and top-notch facilities.

Luxury apartments Altus Dubai Creek offer hotel-like amenities and breathtaking views of the water. The project is wel-connected with the upcoming Blue line of the Metro. Emaar Properties, known for its innovative and high-quality developments, ensures that Altus embodies the pinnacle of modern, comfortable, and stylish living in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Luxury Living Steps Away From the Urban Beach
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Seamless Connectivity: Only a 4-minute walk to the metro, providing easy access to Dubai's attractions and major roads.
  • Sustainable Living: Energy-efficient systems and smart waste management for high sustainability standards.
  • Diverse Residential Options: Elegant 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments available.
  • Proximity to Leisure: Close to Creek Island’s marina, yacht club, and fine dining for a luxurious lifestyle.
  • Lush Green Spaces: Near parks, a lively promenade, and the beach for natural tranquility and urban convenience.
  • Luxurious Design: Sleek architecture with expansive windows and balconies extending living spaces outdoors.
    .

location_tile.title: Enjoy a Lifestyle That Seamlessly Blends Modern Urban Living With Nature
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Creek Harbour is dotted with lush green parks, waterfront promenades, and a marina, offering ample opportunities for outdoor activities and relaxation.

The residential options range from luxurious apartments to spacious townhouses, all equipped with state-of-the-art amenities. In addition to its scenic beauty, Dubai Creek Harbour boasts a vibrant retail and dining scene, world-class educational institutions, and excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai, making it a highly desirable place to live.

5 Minutes to Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
10 Minutes to Burj Khalifa
15 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
40 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Discover Altus Dubai Creek Harbour apartments for sale. Find out about the unit types and amenities in the project by Emaar, located in a tranquil community.

more_info.answer: Altus Dubai Creek Harbour apartments offer luxurious amenities, including scenic views, a swimming pool with sun lounges and cabanas, parks, jogging trails, and access to premium services such as in-residence catering and housekeeping.
more_info.question: What are the features of Altus Dubai Creek Harbour apartments?

more_info.answer: EMAAR Altus is ideally situated in Dubai Creek Harbour, providing residents with easy access to the beach, the iconic Dubai Creek Tower, Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and other key areas.
more_info.question: What is the location of EMAAR Altus in Dubai Creek Harbour?

more_info.answer: Buying an apartment at Altus Dubai Creek Harbour ensures a luxurious lifestyle with top-tier amenities, a prime location, and flexible payment plans, making it an excellent investment opportunity in one of Dubai’s most prestigious areas.
